description: Exact reproduction of exp001 (the untied-vanilla exp709 anchor) on the Nebius H100 under the astarostin user, on an independently-built software stack. IDENTICAL config, IDENTICAL train.py (byte-for-byte copy of exp001's), IDENTICAL data (base_data_climbmix 5-shard subset + tokenizer, md5-verified byte-identical to the gpustar copy), same seed=1. Differs from exp002 only in the environment: fresh venv with torch 2.13.0+cu130 and lutorch_cuda/spiky_cuda rebuilt natively for sm_90, versus exp002's gpustar-user stack. Second cross-check of the 1.2014 bpb on-box anchor, and the first exercise of the experiment workflow from the nebius-h100 native clone. Expected to land on exp001/exp002's 1.2014 within noise; a meaningful disagreement would indicate a stack or numerics bug to chase, not something to average over. Baseline definition (from exp001): MinimalGPT + RoPE, untied head, 35.79M params; exp709 verbatim (depth6/n_embd384/n_head6/seq512, device_bs48, total_bs24576 grad_accum=1, 16K steps = 393M tokens, lr3e-4, wd0.1, warmup0.1, seed1, bf16, vocab32768). Original exp709 reached 1.1922 bpb on the full Nebius ClimbMix; this run uses the local base_data_climbmix subset, so the achieved bpb is the on-box anchor. All hyperplane_ffn ideas compare against THIS number.
